label: Faint stellar outskirts
scope: Tiny and small images only; no full fit or slab bake
modelingChoice: Kacharov density shapes with Rathore placement/orientation and Choi/Oden geometry; not the original equilibrium solution

optimizer.method: Bounded coordinate least squares on global component gains and shared red/green and blue/green ratios; discrete dust-column scale
optimizer.outerGainReason: The photo cannot constrain the far outskirts. Retain the count-normalized radial continuation at the same old-population exposure.

sources: BC03 Z=0.008 Chabrier optical spectra, fixed proxy for VMC Kroupa population colors
SMASH blue observed-color count positions; strict fraction >=0.8; no photograph-derived values
Oden release: qualified Astropy TAN cache, 64 by 64, 0.25 degree pixels
limitations: BC03 and VMC use different IMFs/tracks; luminosity conversion is a fixed proxy with global normalization, not a claimed reproduction of VMC synthesis.
SMASH selection is not a complete, foreground-free young-star catalogue. Counts only redistribute regional age-derived luminosity.

Young-population values are interpolated over 0.25 kpc at survey gaps and blended to the analytic parent. This is an explicit continuity assumption, not measured completeness or invented observations.
Oden cache covers less than the full native Galactic CAR release. Outside support the warp is unknown; a planar continuation with one-degree coverage taper is assumed.
Bell missing cells stay unsupported; no dust column is invented in gaps.
Warp is applied only beyond 4.5 kpc with a two-kpc smooth transition, preserving the accepted inner plane.
DeMCELS still needs qualified full-field input; the empty gas raster is not a measured zero.
